description: This file implements the NnApiDelegateImpl class, which provides an implementation of the Delegate interface for NNAPI inference in TensorFlow Lite. It manages native delegate resources, initializes the delegate with specified options, and provides methods to access the native handle, retrieve error codes, and clean up resources.

classes.name: NnApiDelegateImpl
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle of an NNAPI delegate for TensorFlow Lite, including initialization and cleanup of native resources.

methods.name: NnApiDelegateImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the delegate with specified options and native libraries.

methods.name: getNativeHandle
methods.description: Returns the native handle associated with this delegate.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Explicitly frees resources associated with the delegate by calling native delete functions.

methods.name: getNnapiErrno
methods.description: Retrieves the latest NNAPI error code related to this delegate.
